title: Disclosure Day trailer said '7 billion' but the film says '8 billion'

tellings.quote: that came out, the line in the trailer was 7 billion people have the right to know the truth?

plain: The trailer for Disclosure Day, a film about the government revealing what it knows about UFOs, had a line saying "7 billion people have the right to know the truth," while the film itself says 8 billion, according to Michels. He points this out himself, from watching the trailer, in a conversation that also draws on Bryce Zabel, and treats the change as a telling detail about how the film came together.
